channel.title: Cask & Cup
channel.description: Practical guides to coffee and American whiskey, written in Wisconsin.

item.title: A Beginner's Guide to Bourbon Under $50
item.description: How to read a bourbon label, what bottled-in-bond actually means, and everyday bottles commonly found under $50 — without chasing allocated unicorns.

item.title: How to Make Pour-Over Coffee at Home
item.description: A practical pour-over method you can repeat on a weekday morning, with a starting ratio, a simple bloom, and fixes for sour, bitter, or stalled cups.

item.title: Coffee and Bourbon Pairings That Actually Make Sense
item.description: A simple pairing method — match intensity, then choose complement or contrast — plus starter combinations you can test with everyday coffee and everyday bourbon.

item.title: What Bourbon-Barrel-Aged Coffee Actually Is (and Isn't)
item.description: How barrel-aged coffee is made, how it differs from flavored coffee and coffee liqueur, and how to shop for and brew a bag that actually spent time in a barrel.
